traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports limitation, delay, and hard structure — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Committed, steady, and loyal in relationships and finances. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize connection and limit into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what connection and limit have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Committed, steady, and loyal in relationships and finances. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
